requirements.title: A library move under archive/ that keeps the status
requirements.rationale: Writing the status and moving the directory must be separate calls, so that superseded packages keep their status and an interrupted call can be resumed by moving only.

criteria.condition: ArchiveDestination(specDir, root) is called and `<root>/archive/<base name of specDir>` does not exist
criteria.action: return that path and create, rename or modify no file or directory
criteria.contract: returns (filepath.Join(root, "archive", filepath.Base(specDir)), nil)

setup: a root holding package 03_x and no archive/03_x
check.pseudocode: p, err = ArchiveDestination(dir, root); assert err == nil; assert p == join(root,'archive','03_x'); assert !exists(join(root,'archive'))

criteria.condition: the destination path ArchiveDestination computes already exists or its existence cannot be checked
criteria.action: return an error and write nothing
criteria.contract: returns ("", *SaveError); when the path exists, the message contains `archive conflict: <path> already exists`

setup: case A: root/archive/03_x already exists
case B: root/archive is a regular file, so the destination cannot be checked (ENOTDIR)
check.pseudocode: p, err = ArchiveDestination(dir, root); assert p == ''; assert errors.As(err,&se); assert contains(se.Msg,'archive conflict: '+dest+' already exists')

criteria.condition: MoveUnderArchive(specDir, root) is called on a package that loads, has status `archived` or `superseded`, and has a free destination
criteria.action: create `<root>/archive/` with mode 0755 if it is missing, rename the package directory to the destination, and rewrite no file, so that the status, updated_at and the bytes of every file stay the same
criteria.contract: returns (destination path, nil); specDir no longer exists and the destination holds the identical files

setup: a package copy at root/03_x with status archived, another with status superseded, no root/archive directory
a snapshot of every file's bytes and the modification times
check.pseudocode: dest, err = MoveUnderArchive(dir, root); assert err==nil; assert !exists(dir); assert mode(root/archive)==0755; assert bytes(dest/*) == snapshot

criteria.condition: LoadSpec fails on the package passed to MoveUnderArchive
criteria.action: move nothing and return the load failure unchanged
criteria.contract: returns ("", err) where errors.As(err, *LoadError) is true; the package directory is unchanged

setup: a directory root/03_x whose requirements.json is malformed JSON
check.pseudocode: p, err = MoveUnderArchive(dir, root); assert p==''; assert errors.As(err,&le); assert exists(dir); assert !exists(root/archive)

criteria.condition: MoveUnderArchive is called on a package whose status is neither `archived` nor `superseded`
criteria.action: refuse the move and leave the package in place
criteria.contract: returns ("", *LifecycleError); no directory is created or renamed

setup: packages with status draft, active and sealed at root/NN_x
check.pseudocode: for st in [draft,active,sealed]: p, err = MoveUnderArchive(pkg(st), root); assert errors.As(err,&lce); assert !exists(root/archive)

criteria.condition: MoveUnderArchive finds the destination taken, or creating `<root>/archive/` or the rename fails
criteria.action: leave the package at specDir with its files unchanged
criteria.contract: returns ("", *SaveError); for a taken destination, the error is the one ArchiveDestination returns

setup: case A: archived package with root/archive/03_x existing
case B: archived package in a root made read-only (mode 0555), so creating archive/ fails (skipped when running as uid 0)
check.pseudocode: p, err = MoveUnderArchive(dir, root); assert p==''; assert errors.As(err,&se); assert bytes(dir/*)==snapshot

criteria.condition: MoveToArchive(specDir, root) is called with a free destination
criteria.action: transition any package that is not already `archived` (a superseded one included) to `archived`, then move it with MoveUnderArchive. The existing TestMoveToArchive passes unchanged
criteria.contract: returns nil; the package is at `<root>/archive/<name>` with status `archived`

setup: a sealed package, a superseded package and an already-archived package, each at root/NN_x with a free destination
the existing TestMoveToArchive is kept unchanged
check.pseudocode: assert MoveToArchive(dir,root)==nil; s=LoadSpec(root/archive/NN_x); assert s.Status=='archived'

criteria.condition: MoveToArchive is called and ArchiveDestination reports the destination taken
criteria.action: return before the transition writes anything
criteria.contract: returns *SaveError; the package's status and the bytes of every file at specDir are unchanged

setup: a sealed package at root/03_x and a directory root/archive/03_x
check.pseudocode: err = MoveToArchive(dir,root); assert errors.As(err,&se); assert LoadSpec(dir).Status=='sealed'; assert bytes(dir/*)==snapshot

requirements.title: The --status form and its usage errors
requirements.rationale: Malformed calls must fail as usage errors before any package is loaded or written.

criteria.condition: speca is invoked as `speca <spec> --status S` with S one of `active`, `sealed`, `archived`, or `superseded` together with `--by <spec>`
criteria.action: dispatch the call to the status form, which honours the `--dry-run` and `--force` flags from 11_speca_task_states
criteria.contract: each call reaches the status form (the envelope carries changes, not a report); the dry-run call has result.dry_run true and writes nothing; --force is accepted on the form without a usage error

setup: a spec root with a draft package that has an intent and validates, and a sealed package plus a replacing draft package
check.pseudocode: code = Main(['12_x','--status','active','--dry-run']); assert code==0; assert env.result.dry_run && len(env.result.changes)==1

criteria.condition: `--status draft` is given
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message saying that no move leads back to draft and that a package whose intent must change is superseded by a new one, and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit 2; error stage `usage`, category `usage`; fix_hint {flag: "--status", valid: ["active","sealed","superseded","archived"]}

setup: a valid package directory
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','draft']); assert code==2; assert env.error.fix_hint == {flag:'--status',valid:[...four]}

criteria.condition: `--status` is given a value other than draft that is not one of the four targets
criteria.action: refuse the call and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit 2; stage `usage`, category `usage`; fix_hint {flag: "--status", valid: [the four targets]}

setup: a valid package directory
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','bogus']); assert code==2; assert env.error.fix_hint.valid==four

criteria.condition: `--status superseded` is given without `--by`, `--by` is given without `--status superseded`, `--status` is combined with `--task`/`--state`, `--validate` or `--list`, or `--status` is given with no positional input
criteria.action: refuse the call and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit 2; stage `usage`, category `usage`; no result

setup: a valid package directory and a replacing package
check.pseudocode: for args in cases: code=Main(args); assert code==2; assert env.error.stage=='usage'; assert env.result==nil

criteria.condition: the shared resolver refuses the `--by` reference, or `--by` resolves to the same directory as the input, or the loaded `--by` package has the same spec_id as the input
criteria.action: refuse the call and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit 2; stage `usage`, category `usage`; when the resolver refuses, the message starts with `--by:`

setup: a sealed package 03_old and a replacing package 12_new
a second package whose spec_id equals 03_old's
check.pseudocode: code=Main([old,'--status','superseded','--by','nope']); assert code==2; assert startsWith(env.error.message,'--by:')

criteria.action: describe the --status form and the --by flag in the help text, the flag descriptions and the `--schema` document. The schema gives `status` as an enum of the four targets, and `cmd/speca/testdata/schema.golden.json` matches the output
criteria.contract: the `--schema` output equals the regenerated golden file

setup: cmd/speca/testdata/schema.golden.json regenerated
check.pseudocode: out=Main(['--schema']); assert out==readFile(golden); assert schema.properties.status.enum==four

requirements.title: Checks made before any write
requirements.rationale: A move the format forbids, or one that would silently drop data, must be refused before any file changes.

criteria.action: run the checks of every --status call in this order: load, the move, the target's own checks (activation, sealing, superseding), unknown keys, then the archive destination. The checks also run under --dry-run, and the first check that refuses ends the call
criteria.contract: on a refusal, no file or directory is modified and the envelope has no result

setup: a draft package without an Intent section, with unknown keys, targeted at archived under a taken destination
a sealed package with an unknown key and a taken destination
check.pseudocode: for dry in [false,true]: code=Main(args+dry); assert env.error.stage==expected; assert env.result==nil; assert tree==snapshot

criteria.condition: LoadSpec fails on the input or the --by package, or a loaded package has a schema_version that is neither absent nor 2
criteria.action: refuse the call, naming the directory and naming --by when the replacing package is at fault. The message says that speca changes the state of format version 2 packages only when the version is the cause. --force does not override this
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `load`, category `input`; no result

setup: a malformed input package, a malformed --by package, and a package with schema_version 1
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed','--force']); assert code==1; assert env.error.stage=='load' && env.error.category=='input'

criteria.condition: the target equals the current status, that status is `archived` or `superseded`, and the package is not under archive/
criteria.action: treat the call as a move-only call instead of refusing it as a disallowed transition
criteria.contract: neither call is refused as a disallowed transition; each exits 0 with changes containing a moved entry and no status entry

setup: an archived package and a superseded package at root/NN_x, neither under archive/
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','archived']); assert code==0; assert kinds(env.result.changes)==['moved']

criteria.condition: the call is not move-only and afspec.ValidTransition(status, target) is false
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message naming the package, its status and the target. The message says `already <status>` when target equals status; otherwise it names the shortest sequence of allowed moves to the target when one exists (for active → archived: seal it first with `speca <spec> --status sealed`, then archive it). --force does not override this
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; fix_hint {flag: "--status", valid: allowed_status} when allowed_status is non-empty, and no fix_hint when it is empty

setup: an active package, a draft package, an archived package inside archive/, and a sealed package
check.pseudocode: code=Main([active,'--status','archived','--force']); assert code==1; assert contains(msg,'--status sealed'); assert fix_hint.valid==['sealed']

criteria.action: for any pair of distinct statuses (current, target) where ValidTransition is false, name in the refusal message a sequence of moves that is a shortest chain of ValidTransition steps from current to target when such a chain exists, and name no sequence when none exists
criteria.contract: when a chain of ValidTransition steps exists, the message names a chain whose length equals the breadth-first shortest length; when no chain exists, the message names no sequence of moves

setup: the five statuses draft, active, sealed, superseded, archived
check.pseudocode: for (c,t) in pairs where !ValidTransition(c,t): msg=refusalMessage(c,t); sp=bfs(c,t); if sp!=nil: assert chainIn(msg)==sp-length else assert chainIn(msg)==none

criteria.condition: a call that rewrites package files (sealing, archiving or superseding, not move-only) is made without --force on a package for which Validate reports one or more `unknown_field` errors
criteria.action: refuse the call, naming each file and unknown key
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; fix_hint.flag `--force`; no file modified

setup: an active package whose prd.md frontmatter has a key the schema does not allow, and a sealed package with an unknown key in tasks.json
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed']); assert code==1; assert env.error.fix_hint.flag=='--force'; assert contains(msg,'prd.md') && contains(msg,'badkey'); assert tree==snapshot

criteria.condition: --force is given on a sealing, archiving or superseding call whose package has `unknown_field` errors
criteria.action: go ahead with the call and raise a warning naming the keys the write drops
criteria.contract: envelope warning with code `spec_invalid` and severity `high`

setup: an active package with no open task whose prd.md has an unknown key
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed','--force']); assert code==0; w=warning('spec_invalid'); assert w.severity=='high' && contains(w.message,'badkey')

criteria.condition: a move that ends under archive/ starts from a package not under archive/, and afspec.ArchiveDestination(dir, holding directory) reports the destination taken
criteria.action: refuse the call, naming the existing directory, and write nothing
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `archive`, category `disk`, resumable false; no result

setup: a sealed package at root/03_x and a directory root/archive/03_x
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','archived','--force']); assert code==1; assert env.error.stage=='archive'; assert env.resumable==false; assert env.result==nil; assert bytes(dir/*)==snapshot

requirements.title: Activation
requirements.rationale: An active package must have an intent to hash and should validate, which is the verdict `spec` uses before it activates.

criteria.condition: `--status active` is given for a draft package whose body has a `## Intent` section and whose Validate result is valid
criteria.action: set updated_at and call Transition("active", dir), leaving the package in its directory
criteria.contract: exit 0; result status `active` with the new intent_hash; changes [{kind: status, from: draft, to: active}]

setup: a draft package that validates and has a `## Intent` section
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','active']); assert code==0; assert env.result.status=='active'; assert env.result.intent_hash!=''; assert env.result.changes==[{kind:'status',from:'draft',to:'active'}]

criteria.condition: afspec.HasIntent(PRDBody) is false for the package being activated
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message telling the caller to add a `## Intent` section to prd.md, spelled exactly so on a line of its own. --force does not override this
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; no file modified

setup: a draft package whose prd.md has no `## Intent` section
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','active','--force']); assert code==1; assert contains(msg,'\n## Intent\n') ; assert tree==snapshot

criteria.condition: the package being activated has a Validate result that is not valid and --force is not given
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message naming the failing rules
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `validate`, category `invalid_spec`; fix_hint.flag `--force`; no file modified

setup: a draft package with an intent that fails Validate
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','active']); assert code==1; assert env.error.category=='invalid_spec'; assert env.error.fix_hint.flag=='--force'

criteria.condition: --force is given on an activation whose package does not validate
criteria.action: activate the package and raise a warning naming the failing rules
criteria.contract: exit 0; envelope warning code `spec_invalid`, severity `high`

setup: a draft package with an intent that fails Validate
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','active','--force']); assert code==0; assert warning('spec_invalid').severity=='high'

criteria.condition: --dry-run is given on an activation that passes its checks
criteria.action: report in the result the intent_hash that ComputeIntentHash gives for the body, without writing
criteria.contract: result.intent_hash equals ComputeIntentHash(PRDBody); prd.md is unchanged

setup: a draft package that validates and has an intent
check.pseudocode: h,_=ComputeIntentHash(body); Main([dir,'--status','active','--dry-run']); assert env.result.intent_hash==h; assert bytes(prd.md)==snapshot

requirements.title: Sealing
requirements.rationale: A sealed package must be finished and must not make an intent drift permanent.

criteria.condition: `--status sealed` is given for an active package with no intent drift and no open task
criteria.action: set updated_at and call Transition("sealed", dir), leaving the package in its directory
criteria.contract: exit 0; result status `sealed`; changes [{kind: status, from: active, to: sealed}]

setup: an active package, all tasks done or dropped, intent unchanged
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed']); assert code==0; assert env.result.status=='sealed'; assert env.result.changes==[{kind:'status',from:'active',to:'sealed'}]

criteria.condition: the package being sealed has intent drift
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message telling the caller to restore the intent that was activated or to write a new package that supersedes this one. --force does not override this
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; no fix_hint; no file modified

setup: an active package whose prd.md Intent section was edited after activation, and another whose Intent section was removed
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed','--force']); assert code==1; assert env.error.fix_hint==nil; assert tree==snapshot

criteria.condition: the package being sealed has one or more open tasks and --force is not given
criteria.action: refuse the call with a message naming each open task with its state and telling the caller to finish or drop it
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; fix_hint.flag `--force`; no file modified

setup: an active package with one pending task and one optional in_progress task
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed']); assert contains(msg,'pending') && contains(msg,'in_progress'); assert env.error.fix_hint.flag=='--force'

criteria.condition: --force is given on a sealing call whose package has open tasks and no intent drift
criteria.action: seal the package and raise a warning listing each open task and its state
criteria.contract: exit 0; envelope warning code `tasks_open`, severity `high`

setup: an active package with a pending task and an in_progress task and no drift
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed','--force']); assert code==0; w=warning('tasks_open'); assert w.severity=='high' && contains(w.message,'in_progress')

requirements.title: Archiving
requirements.rationale: Format §9.2 requires an archived package to sit under archive/.

criteria.condition: `--status archived` is given for a draft, sealed or superseded package that is not under archive/
criteria.action: set updated_at, call Transition("archived", dir), then call MoveUnderArchive(dir, holding directory)
criteria.contract: exit 0; the package is at `<holding>/archive/<name>` with status `archived`; changes [status, moved] in that order

setup: a sealed package at root/03_x; also a draft package at root/04_y and a superseded package at root/05_z
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','archived']); assert kinds(changes)==['status','moved']; assert LoadSpec(root/archive/03_x).Status=='archived'

criteria.condition: `--status archived` is given for a draft, sealed or superseded package already under archive/
criteria.action: call Transition("archived", dir) only and leave the directory where it is
criteria.contract: exit 0; changes [{kind: status}] only

setup: a sealed package at root/archive/03_x
check.pseudocode: code=Main([root+'/archive/03_x','--status','archived']); assert kinds(changes)==['status']; assert exists(root/archive/03_x)

criteria.condition: a move-only call is made with `--status archived`
criteria.action: call MoveUnderArchive only, rewriting no file and leaving updated_at unchanged
criteria.contract: exit 0; changes [{kind: moved}] only; the package files are byte-identical at the new location

setup: an archived package at root/03_x outside archive/, files snapshotted
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','archived']); assert kinds(changes)==['moved']; assert bytes(root/archive/03_x/*)==snapshot

requirements.title: Superseding
requirements.rationale: Format §9.1 requires the banner and the superseded status on the old package, the old id in the new package's supersedes, and the old folder under archive/.

criteria.condition: the --by package has a status other than draft, active or sealed
criteria.action: refuse the call. --force does not override this
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`; fix_hint.flag `--by`; no file modified

setup: a sealed old package and replacing packages with status superseded and archived
check.pseudocode: code=Main([old,'--status','superseded','--by',rep,'--force']); assert code==1; assert env.error.fix_hint.flag=='--by'; assert tree==snapshot

criteria.condition: `--status superseded --by R` is given for a sealed package that passes every check
criteria.action: in this order: call Supersede(R's spec_id, dir); append the old spec_id to the end of R's supersedes with Save, unless it is already there; then call MoveUnderArchive(dir, holding directory) unless the package is already under archive/. The status stays `superseded`
criteria.contract: exit 0; the package sits under archive/ with status `superseded` and the DEPRECATED banner; changes [status, supersedes, moved] in that order, omitting the steps that did not run

setup: a sealed package 03_old and a draft replacing package 12_new with an empty supersedes
check.pseudocode: code=Main([old,'--status','superseded','--by',new]); assert kinds(changes)==['status','supersedes','moved']; assert LoadSpec(new).Supersedes contains oldID

criteria.condition: the replacing package is sealed, is active with intent drift, has `unknown_field` errors, or its Save fails
criteria.action: skip or abandon the supersedes record and complete the rest of the call. --force does not extend to the replacing package
criteria.contract: exit 0; envelope warning code `supersedes_not_recorded`, severity `low`, naming the replacing package's directory, the id not recorded and the reason; no supersedes change

setup: replacing packages that are: sealed; active with intent drift; carrying an unknown_field error; and a draft whose Save fails (directory made read-only)
check.pseudocode: code=Main(args); assert code==0; w=warning('supersedes_not_recorded'); assert w.severity=='low'; assert kinds(changes)==['status','moved']

criteria.condition: a move-only call is made with `--status superseded --by R`
criteria.action: skip Supersede, add the old spec_id to R's supersedes only if it is still missing, and move the package with MoveUnderArchive
criteria.contract: exit 0; changes [supersedes (when added), moved]; the old package's files are unchanged

setup: a superseded package at root/03_old outside archive/, and a replacing package whose supersedes lacks the old id
check.pseudocode: code=Main([old,'--status','superseded','--by',new]); assert kinds(changes)==['supersedes','moved']; assert bytes(root/archive/03_old/*)==snapshot

criteria.action: for any sequence of superseding calls naming the same old package and the same replacing package, leave the old spec_id in the replacing package's supersedes exactly once
criteria.contract: the old spec_id occurs exactly once in the replacing package's supersedes; entries that were already there keep their order

setup: a sealed old package and a draft replacing package with an arbitrary existing supersedes list
check.pseudocode: for n in 1..5: repeat n times Main([oldPathNow,'--status','superseded','--by',new]); assert count(LoadSpec(new).Supersedes, oldID)==1

requirements.title: Writing, failures while writing, and resuming
requirements.rationale: A failure part way through must say what was written and how to finish it.

criteria.action: set updated_at to the current UTC time in RFC 3339 on every package it writes, before writing it
criteria.contract: updated_at in the written prd.md parses with time.RFC3339, is in UTC, and is not earlier than the call's start time truncated to the second

setup: a start time truncated to the second
an active package to seal, and a sealed one to supersede with a draft replacing package
check.pseudocode: t=parse(RFC3339, LoadSpec(dir).UpdatedAt); assert t.Location()==UTC; assert !t.Before(start.Truncate(second))

criteria.condition: Transition or Supersede returns a *SaveError
criteria.action: end the call with the library's message
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `write`, category `disk`; no result

setup: an active package whose directory is read-only (mode 0555) so the temporary file cannot be created (skipped as uid 0)
check.pseudocode: chmod(dir,0555); code=Main([dir,'--status','sealed']); assert code==1; assert env.error.stage=='write' && env.error.category=='disk'; assert env.result==nil

criteria.condition: a *LifecycleError or *IntentError reaches the write despite the checks
criteria.action: end the call
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `status`, category `lifecycle`

setup: the status form with a stubbed library call that returns *LifecycleError, then *IntentError
check.pseudocode: for e in [&LifecycleError{}, &IntentError{}]: stub.transition=e; code=run(); assert code==1; assert stage=='status' && category=='lifecycle'

criteria.condition: MoveUnderArchive fails after the status was written
criteria.action: end the call with a message naming the directory the package is in now and its new status, and saying that running the same call again moves it. The summary says that the status was written and the move was not
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `archive`, category `disk`, resumable true, retryable false; result present with spec_dir at the current location, the new status, and changes listing what was written; next holds the same call against the current spec_dir, with --by when superseding

setup: a sealed package at root/03_x in a read-only root (mode 0555 on root, package directory writable) so the status write succeeds and the rename fails; skipped as uid 0
the same case for superseding with --by
check.pseudocode: code=Main([dir,'--status','archived']); assert code==1; assert env.resumable && !env.retryable; assert env.result.changes==[status]; assert env.next[0].flags==['--status','archived']

criteria.condition: the same call is run again after an archive-stage failure
criteria.action: move the package under archive/ as a move-only call and change nothing else
criteria.contract: exit 0; changes contain only `moved` (and `supersedes` if it was still missing); the files are byte-identical to the ones left by the failed call

setup: a package left after a failed archive call, with its files snapshotted, and the cause (read-only root) cleared
check.pseudocode: fail=Main(args); chmod(root,0755); snap=snapshot(dir); code=Main(args); assert code==0; assert kinds(changes)==['moved']; assert bytes(dest/*)==snap

criteria.condition: reading the package back with LoadSpec after a successful write fails
criteria.action: end the call and report the writes that were made
criteria.contract: exit 1; stage `load`, category `input`; result carries changes

setup: the status form with a stubbed read-back loader that fails after Transition succeeded
check.pseudocode: stub.loadAfterWrite=fail; code=run(); assert env.error.stage=='load'; assert len(env.result.changes)==1

criteria.action: implement Resumable() bool, returning true only for the archive-stage failure
criteria.contract: envelope `resumable` is true only for exit 1 at stage `archive` after a status write

setup: Result values for: success, refusal, write-stage failure, load-stage failure after write, archive-stage failure after a status write
check.pseudocode: assert Result{archiveFail}.Resumable()==true; for r in others: assert !r.Resumable()

requirements.title: Result, summary, dry run and next
requirements.rationale: An agent must see what changed, and must be offered only calls that will succeed.

criteria.condition: a --status call succeeds without --dry-run
criteria.action: return the package as the report form of 10_speca_state_report reports it, read back with LoadSpec from where the package now is, with spec_dir shown by the display rule. Changes are listed in write order using the shapes {kind: status, from, to}, {kind: supersedes, spec, added} and {kind: moved, from, to} with display paths
criteria.contract: result.spec_dir is the post-move directory; result.changes is ordered status, supersedes, moved

setup: a sealed package at root/03_x
check.pseudocode: Main([dir,'--status','archived']); assert result.spec_dir==display(root/archive/03_x); assert result.status=='archived'

criteria.condition: --dry-run is given
criteria.action: produce the same exit code, refusals, warnings, changes and result as the real call, computing the result from the state held in memory, and modify no file or directory
criteria.contract: result.dry_run is true; the file tree and every modification time are unchanged

setup: a set of calls: activation, sealing with --force and open tasks, archiving, superseding with a replacing package, a refusal, each with a snapshot of tree and modification times
check.pseudocode: d=Main(args+['--dry-run']); assert tree==snapshot; r=Main(args); assert d.changes==r.changes && d.exit==r.exit; assert d.result.dry_run

criteria.action: emit one summary sentence per call in the forms `speca: activated <name>`, `speca: sealed <name>`, `speca: archived <name>, moved to <display path>`, `speca: superseded <name> by <spec_id>, moved to <display path>` and `speca: moved <name> to <display path>`. Under --dry-run the sentence ends with ` (dry run; nothing written)`
criteria.contract: envelope summary matches the form for the move made

setup: successful calls for activate, seal, archive, supersede and move-only
check.pseudocode: assert env.summary=='speca: sealed 09_x'; assert dry.summary==env.summary+' (dry run; nothing written)'

criteria.condition: a --status call ends without --dry-run
criteria.action: suggest in next, after activation, the claim `speca <spec_dir> --task N --state in_progress` for next_task when that task is ready. After sealing, archiving, superseding, a move-only call or a refusal, suggest nothing
criteria.contract: envelope next has one entry or is empty, as described

setup: a draft package whose next_task is ready; sealed, archived, superseded and move-only calls; a refusal
check.pseudocode: Main([dir,'--status','active']); assert env.next[0].flags==['--task',N,'--state','in_progress']; Main([dir,'--status','sealed']); assert len(env.next)==0

criteria.condition: --dry-run is given on a call that passes its checks
criteria.action: suggest in next the same call without --dry-run
criteria.contract: next[0] carries the same input and flags minus `--dry-run`

setup: a call that passes its checks
check.pseudocode: d=Main([dir,'--status','sealed','--dry-run']); assert d.next[0].flags==['--status','sealed']

criteria.condition: the report form `speca <spec>` reports a draft package whose Validate is valid and whose body has a `## Intent` section
criteria.action: list `speca <spec_dir> --status active` in next before any task suggestion
criteria.contract: next[0].flags are ["--status", "active"]

setup: a draft package that validates and whose body has `## Intent`, with a task ready
check.pseudocode: Main([dir]); assert env.next[0].flags==['--status','active']

criteria.condition: the report form reports an active package with no open task
criteria.action: list `speca <spec_dir> --status sealed` in next, and leave the --list form's next unchanged
criteria.contract: next contains an entry with flags ["--status", "sealed"]

setup: an active package with all tasks done or dropped
an active package with a pending task
check.pseudocode: Main([done]); assert any(n.flags==['--status','sealed']); Main([open]); assert none

criteria.action: for any package for which the report form suggests a --status call, run that suggested call without a refusal
criteria.contract: the suggested call exits 0

setup: generated packages: draft, active, sealed, superseded or archived; with or without Intent; valid or invalid; with arbitrary task states; with or without intent drift and unknown keys
check.pseudocode: for pkg in gen(): r=Main([pkg]); for n in r.next where '--status' in n.flags: assert Main([n.input]+n.flags)==0

requirements.title: Output types and warning codes
requirements.rationale: Agents decode the envelope by type and by warning code, so the new fields and codes must exist in the public package.

criteria.action: give Change the fields `spec` and `added`, both tagged `omitempty` and both carrying `description` tags
criteria.contract: a Change of kind `status` marshals without the keys spec and added; a Change of kind `supersedes` marshals with them

setup: envelope.Change values of kind status, moved and supersedes
check.pseudocode: b=json.Marshal(Change{Kind:'status',From:'a',To:'b'}); assert !has(b,'spec') && !has(b,'added'); assert has(json.Marshal(Change{Kind:'supersedes',Spec:'12',Added:'03'}),'added')

criteria.action: declare WarnTasksOpen = "tasks_open" and WarnSupersedesNotRecorded = "supersedes_not_recorded", and have internal/cli/warn.go declare aliases for both with warnStages entries of "status"
criteria.contract: a warning raised with either code carries stage `status`

setup: envelope.WarnTasksOpen and envelope.WarnSupersedesNotRecorded with internal/cli aliases
check.pseudocode: assert WarnTasksOpen=='tasks_open'; run.Warn(WarnTasksOpen,'high','x'); assert run.Warnings()[0].Stage=='status'

criteria.action: import only standard library packages
criteria.contract: every import in the envelope package resolves to a standard library package

setup: all non-test Go files of package envelope
check.pseudocode: for imp in imports(envelope/*.go): assert !contains(first(imp,'/'),'.')

execution_paths.title: An agent activates a draft package

steps.action: runs `speca 12_x --status active` on a draft package that validates and has a ## Intent section
resolves and loads the package, checks the move with ValidTransition, HasIntent and Validate
sets updated_at and calls afspec Transition("active", dir), which writes the status and intent_hash
reads the package back with LoadSpec and emits exit 0 with result status active, intent_hash and changes [status], plus a next claim for the ready next_task

setup: a spec root with draft package 10_x that validates and has a `## Intent` section and a ready first task
end_state: prd.md has status active and an intent_hash
result status is active with intent_hash and changes [status]
next carries the claim of the ready next_task

execution_paths.title: The report form suggests sealing and the agent seals

steps.action: runs `speca 09_x` on an active package whose tasks are all done
emits a report whose next contains `speca <spec_dir> --status sealed`
runs the suggested `speca <spec_dir> --status sealed`
checks for intent drift, open tasks and unknown keys, sets updated_at and calls Transition("sealed", dir)
emits exit 0 with result status sealed and summary `speca: sealed 09_x`

setup: a spec root with an active package 09_x whose tasks are all done
end_state: the report next contains the sealing suggestion
the second call exits 0 with result status sealed and summary `speca: sealed 09_x`
tasks.json and prd.md on disk show the sealed status

execution_paths.title: An agent archives a sealed package

steps.action: runs `speca 03_x --status archived` on a sealed package in the spec root
checks the move and confirms with afspec ArchiveDestination that `<root>/archive/03_x` is free
calls Transition("archived", dir) and then afspec MoveUnderArchive(dir, root)
reads the package back from `<root>/archive/03_x` and emits exit 0 with changes [status, moved]

setup: a spec root with sealed package 03_x and no archive directory
end_state: 03_x no longer exists in the root and root/archive/03_x holds the package with status archived

execution_paths.title: An agent supersedes a sealed package with a replacing package

steps.action: runs `speca 03_old --status superseded --by 12_new`
loads both packages and checks the replacing package's status, unknown keys and the archive destination
calls Supersede("12", dir), which writes the banner and the superseded status
appends the old spec_id to 12_new's supersedes and saves it with Save
moves 03_old with MoveUnderArchive and emits exit 0 with changes [status, supersedes, moved] and status superseded

setup: a spec root with sealed package 03_old and draft package 12_new
end_state: root/archive/03_old has status superseded and the DEPRECATED banner
changes are [status, supersedes, moved] and summary names the old package, spec 12 and the archive path

execution_paths.title: An interrupted archive is resumed by running the same call again

steps.action: runs `speca 03_x --status archived` and the directory rename fails after the status write
emits exit 1 at stage archive, category disk, resumable true, with result changes [status] and next holding the same call
runs the suggested call again once the cause is cleared
recognises a move-only call, calls MoveUnderArchive without rewriting any file, and emits exit 0 with changes [moved]

setup: a sealed package 03_x in a root made read-only after the package directory stays writable (skipped as uid 0)
end_state: the first call exits 1 at stage archive, category disk, resumable true, with changes [status] and next holding the same call
the second call exits 0 with changes [moved] only
root/archive/03_x holds the package with status archived and files unchanged since the failed call
